risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively specific and well quantified, including segment trends, pricing, volumes, currency effects, cost savings, charges, and operating margins. Risk factors include substantial currency losses, volume declines, inflationary and manufacturing costs, pension expense, severance charges, and intense competition, but improved pricing and cost savings supported higher 2009 operating profit. Boilerplate strategic language and dense presentation modestly reduce transparency.
